# `DiskEject`

<!-- Generated by tools/gen_cards.py from catalog/. Do not edit by hand. -->

Queued storage-eject status notification.

## Summary

| Item | Value |
|---|---|
| Kind | event (device sends) |
| Grade | PURE GETTER |
| Side-effect tier | B |
| Confidence | READ |
| Basis | static analysis of firmware 9.31, CStorageHotPlug::AddEjectEvent @0x317fd0 (both callers in CStorageHotPlug::RunUmount), CStorageHotPlug::Eject, CStorageHotPlug::NotifyEvents @0x315e60 (64-bit build) |

The storage hot-plug component queues an eject status (stage string plus storage type) and later flushes queued events, broadcasting each on TCP 4700 (channel I). Delivery is therefore deferred relative to the eject step it reports. state is complete when the requested unmount succeeded (or the storage was already unmounted) and fail when it did not, in which case the storage stays mounted; no code or error is added. An eject request for storage that is not mounted produces no DiskEject, and physical removal produces DeviceChange with arrival false instead. Family: queued custom. APK: defined constant only; no Event branch established.

Side effects: Observation only.

## Request params

None. Events are sent by the device without a request; the payload is below.

## Payload

| Name | Type | Required | Default | Notes |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `Event` | string | yes | - | Discriminator. Fixed value `"DiskEject"`. [READ] |
| `Timestamp` | string | yes | - | Decimal string with nine fractional digits from a monotonic clock; not a calendar time. [READ] |
| `state` | string | yes | - | complete when the unmount succeeded or the storage was already unmounted; fail when it did not (the storage stays mounted). One of: `complete`, `fail`. [READ] |
| `device` | string | yes | - | Storage-type name. [READ] |

## Errors

None. Failures appear in the payload (`code`, `error`) when `state` is `fail`.

## Example

Event, eject - READ shape, not captured; values invented:

```json
{"Event":"DiskEject","Timestamp":"1234.123456789","state":"complete","device":"udisk"}
```
